personality_one_liner: A guided, high-trust experience that turns complex utility bills into clear, actionable savings through clean typography and iOS-native simplicity.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Use 'md' or 'lg' padding inside cards. Avoid dense dashboard-style layouts.

do's: Featured savings cards over hero imagery

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A guided entry point featuring a large hero CTA to scan a bill and category selectors.

states.empty: Default state shows 'Carica la tua bolletta e scopri se puoi spendere meno'.
states.error: Error banner under header if network fails.

screens.layout: F-shaped scanning. Hero card with glassmorphism overlay containing 'Analizza la mia bolletta' CTA. Below: horizontal scroll or grid for Luce, Gas, Telefonia. Bottom: recent activity or tips.

screens.name: Upload & Extract
screens.purpose: Camera/PDF upload flow followed by a skeleton/loading extraction screen showing parsed data.

states.loading: Animated scanning overlay on the document.
states.empty: Prompt to select Camera or PDF.

screens.layout: Full screen camera/upload modal. Once uploaded, a structured list card displaying Fornitore, Consumi, Prezzo, etc. Sticky 'Conferma' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: Analysis & Compare
screens.purpose: Shows current spend vs proposed offer and calculates annual savings.
screens.layout: Top: Current situation summary (Spesa attuale). Middle: Our Proposal (La nostra proposta) as a featured card with a soft gradient background. Highlight 'Risparmio stimato Z euro l'anno' in success color. Sticky primary CTA 'Voglio questa offerta'.

screens.name: Contract & Sign
screens.purpose: Collect user data, review contract, and capture digital signature.
screens.layout: Multi-step form. Single column inputs with labels above. Progress bar at top. PDF viewer for contract. Digital signature pad. Sticky submit button in KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Customer Area
screens.purpose: Dashboard for users to track supplies, past bills, and offer statuses.

states.empty: Illustration with 'Non hai ancora contratti attivi'.

screens.layout: Bottom tabs: 'Le mie forniture', 'Le mie bollette', 'Le mie offerte'. Clean lists with status badges (e.g. In lavorazione, Accettata) in brandTertiary with onBrandTertiary text. Minimum 56pt tappable rows.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Admin view to manage queues, proposals, and view statistics.
screens.layout: Top: 2-column grid of stat tiles (Bollette analizzate, Valore generato). Middle: Queue of 'Da analizzare'. Bottom: Recent contracts. High information density but clear iOS spacing.

empty_folder.alt: Minimal 3D paper fold representing an empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to the iOS-Native Clean personality. Keep layouts spacious and clean with clear visual hierarchy. Use generous padding (md/lg) in cards.
Do NOT use any blue colors. Use the defined brand Moss Green and accents like Terracotta, Ochre, and Sage. The theme should exude trust and savings.
Always apply a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) behind text when overlaying over images (e.g., hero background) to ensure contrast.
Implement glassmorphism for sticky headers and the bottom tab bar, ensuring readability with underlying tinted base.
Primary CTA buttons must stick to the bottom of the screen (inside a KeyboardAvoidingView for forms) to ensure easy thumb reach, regardless of scroll position.
Ensure max font weight is 500 across all text elements; rely on size (e.g., lg, xl, 2xl) to convey hierarchy instead of heavy bolding.
For multi-step forms, place labels strictly above inputs, use a single column layout, and never use floating labels.
In the Customer Area and Admin Dashboard, use minimum 56pt row heights for tappable items with clear leading icons and trailing chevrons where appropriate.
